# fabric_semantic_model_connection_bindings (Data Source)

The Semantic Model Connection Bindings data-source allows you to retrieve a list of Fabric [Semantic Model Connection Bindings](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/fabric/semanticmodel/items/bind-semantic-model-connection).

-> This data-source supports Service Principal authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fabric_semantic_model_connection_bindings" "example" {
  workspace_id      = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  semantic_model_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `semantic_model_id` (String) The semantic model ID.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID that contains the semantic model.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `values` (Attributes Set) The set of connection bindings for the semantic model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

<a id="nestedatt--values"></a>

### Nested Schema for `values`

Read-Only:

- `connection_details` (Attributes) The semantic model data-source reference for this binding. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values--connection_details))
- `connection_id` (String) The ID of the Fabric connection.
- `connectivity_type` (String) The current connectivity type. `None` means the data-source reference is currently unbound.
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the bound Fabric connection.
- `gateway_id` (String) The ID of the gateway used by the bound connection.
- `id` (String) A stable identifier for this binding.

<a id="nestedatt--values--connection_details"></a>

### Nested Schema for `values.connection_details`

Read-Only:

- `path` (String) The path of the semantic model data-source reference.
- `type` (String) The type of the semantic model data-source reference.
